moment: Tattered black ghost ship under a moon in fog; a gold dotted trail runs along the waterline to an X
why: Torn black sails, glowing stern windows and mist read as the Black Pearl; dotted route to an X is a treasure-chart motif.

moment: Home-built quadcopter hovering in a sunlit courtyard of a sandstone, pillared campus building
why: Indian-style engineering-campus architecture and a flying-camera drone recall the film's college and Rancho's flying camera; weaker than the classroom frames.

moment: Ghost ship dimmed behind a gold compass with a dashed vertical route of waypoints
why: Same Black Pearl-like hull; compass plus dashed route reads as a pirate chart.

moment: Golden-hour valley with a river and a lone horse, dark oak in the foreground, thin line across the lower third
why: Painterly amber sunset vista with a grazing horse is the game's landscape/photo-mode look.

moment: Dusk camp: lantern-lit canvas tent, cook pot over a fire, mountains and pines at twilight
why: Gang-camp set dressing with tent, cauldron and wagon wheel.

moment: Quadcopter hovering in front of a stone-arcade college building with a drone icon and a pill button
why: Same campus and drone as above; inferred from the film's engineering-college setting.

moment: Sunset camp with horses at a rail, covered wagon, tents, campfire and a lake
why: Frontier camp composition with covered wagon and horses.

moment: Yellow Vespa scooter on a pebbly lake shore under snow-capped mountains, a row of small gate marks above
why: Yellow scooter beside a high-altitude blue lake is the Pangong Tso ending.

moment: Candles floating against a starry sky, with thin forked streaks (quill or broom trails)
why: Floating candles against stars is the Great Hall ceiling; the streaks are ambiguous.

moment: Top of the Marauder's Map: folded parchment, ribbon banner, compass rosettes in the corners
why: Creased cream parchment with banner, ink corridors and compass rosettes is the Marauder's Map.

moment: Sunset sea with a lone tall ship on the horizon leaving a glowing wake, treasure map with skull gear below
why: Tall ship on a horizon, compass and skull-gear chart with an X is pirate-adventure.

moment: Moonlit ghost ship with a gold compass linked by a thin line
why: Black Pearl-like ship, torn sails, lantern-lit stern.

moment: Crimson dusk over a homestead with a tree and fence, crows overhead, X target marks in the sky
why: Red-tinted western vista with X targets recalls Dead Eye.

moment: Open journal spread with pencil sketches of a ladder, lake, pines, a saddled horse and a taped note
why: Cream sketchbook with taped notes and pencil sketches evokes Arthur Morgan's journal.

moment: Dark candlelit room with floating candles, a parchment on the floor with black veins, castle outside tall windows
why: Floating candles and gothic windows with a castle suggest Hogwarts at night; the parchment is less specific.

moment: Black night sea with a glowing teal wave, a distant tall ship and a gold compass
why: Cursed-sea teal glow and a lone square-rigger fit At World's End.

moment: Same teal-lit night sea with the compass at the right and a ship on the horizon
why: As above; Sea of Thieves is a plausible alternative.

moment: Red-sky homestead with a white line passing through pink X marks along the fence
why: X target marks joined by a line over a western landscape recall Dead Eye.

moment: Silver pen in an open velvet box beside a pocket stopwatch on a polished desk, chalkboard with a drone sketch behind
why: Pen gift on a classroom desk; I infer it from the matching classroom set.

moment: Wooden notice board with pinned weathered posters and one big blank poster
why: Western wanted-poster board; genre-level evidence only.

moment: Rows of floating candles in a starry navy sky
why: Floating candles over stars matches the Great Hall ceiling.

moment: Castle on a rock above a black lake at night, a broom hovering, floating candles reflected in the water
why: Castle on a cliff over a lake with a broom and floating candles is Hogwarts.

moment: Green chalkboard in a sunbeam with a chalk drone sketch and a bar chart
why: Indian-college lecture-hall board; chalk drone ties it to the same classroom set.

moment: The Great Hall: long tables with plates, floating candles under a gothic ceiling, tall blue window
why: Floating candles over house tables in a gothic hall.

moment: Yellow scooter circled with a tick beside a high-altitude blue lake at sunrise
why: Pangong Tso scooter shot from the film's ending.

moment: Quiet night camp with two tents and a small fire, mountains in blue dark
why: Gang camp at night with fireflies matches the game's camp mood.

moment: Stormy sea with a teal breaking wave, compass-and-trail map with a skull gear below
why: Storm sea, gold compass, X route and skull gear read as pirate adventure; no single iconic shot.

moment: Great Hall with floating candles and laid tables, a progress line at the bottom
why: Floating candles and house tables in a gothic hall.

moment: Sunset valley with a river and a grazing horse, big tree silhouette on the left
why: Amber vista with a grazing horse is the game's landscape look.

moment: Moonlit harbour with moored tall ships and dock lanterns; a compass-and-gear treasure route with an X below
why: Port town with masts and lantern reflections plus compass, dashed route and X.

moment: Middle of the Marauder's Map: creased parchment, double-ruled corridors, footprints
why: Folded parchment with ink corridors and footprint trails.

moment: Journal spread with sketches of mountains, a lake, pines, birds, a saddled horse, a taped note and a red underline
why: Sketchbook spread with pencil landscape and taped note evokes Arthur's journal.

moment: Floating candles in a dark blue sky, one picked out by a teal reticle
why: Hundreds of floating lit candles in a night void is the Great Hall ceiling image; the reticle is a UI overlay.

moment: Empty lecture hall with a chalk drone sketch and 'AAL IZZ WELL' on the board, sunlit colonnade
why: The slogan lettered on the board, stone walls and wooden benches match the film's classroom.

moment: Red steam train crossing a stone viaduct over a Highland lake
why: The Hogwarts Express on the Glenfinnan Viaduct.

moment: Lecture hall with a chalk drone sketch and 'AAL IZZ WEL' being written
why: Slogan on the board, stone walls, and benches.

moment: Silver pen in a velvet-lined wooden box and a pocket stopwatch on a lecture desk, drone sketch on the board behind
why: Pen gift on a classroom desk; inferred from the matching classroom set.
